question: Among all German drivers born between 1980 and 1985 who participated in races since 2010, find the one with the fastest qualifying time in Q2. Return their full name and the name of the race where this Q2 time was recorded.

prediction.sql:
SELECT d."XCL_038", d."XCL_039", r."XCL_069"
FROM drivers AS d
INNER JOIN qualifying AS q ON d."XCL_034" = q."XCL_058"
INNER JOIN races AS r ON q."XCL_057" = r."XCL_065"
WHERE d."XCL_041" = 'German'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', d."XCL_040") BETWEEN '1980' AND '1985'
  AND r."XCL_066" >= 2010
  AND q."XCL_063" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY (CAST(SUBSTRING(q."XCL_063", 1, INSTR(q."XCL_063", ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60)
       + (CAST(SUBSTRING(q."XCL_063", INSTR(q."XCL_063", ':') + 1, INSTR(q."XCL_063", '.') - INSTR(q."XCL_063", ':') - 1) AS REAL))
       + (CAST(SUBSTRING(q."XCL_063", INSTR(q."XCL_063", '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) ASC
LIMIT 1
